messages:
Lucas: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need single-page runbook edits: triage commands, escalation steps, and a safe ops section. Keep it concise.

Maya: I'll draft a one-page 'Initial Triage' with 5 checks + exact commands.

Raj: I'll add fallback routing info (model id, route header, perf note) and how to force-route for emergencies.

Jamie: I'll own the escalation timeline: 0m ack, 5m eng-oncall notify, 15m page eng-lead. Will include Slack webhook example.

Sophie: Ops: include guarded prefix flush with dry_run and mandatory lead confirmation. Small snippet: `curl -X POST https://admin.internal/flush-prefix -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"prefix":"user-kv","dry_run":true}'`.

Maya: Triage checks I'll include: pod health + logs, redis memory/evictions, cache_miss_rate, queue depth, quick fallback. Commands + sample outputs in PR.

Raj: Fallback policy example I'll document: set header `X-Model: redwood/quant-v2` and expected ~+15-20% latency, -40% cost. Also add quick rollback steps.

Jamie: Timeline & owners: maya (triage) due 2026-04-09, raj (fallback) due 2026-04-10, jamie (escalation) due 2026-04-08, sophie (safe ops checklist) due 2026-04-08.

karen-bot: Task created: TASK-4777 "Postmortem playbook edits: triage, escalation, fallback, safe-ops" assigned to maya, raj, jamie, sophie. Due 2026-04-10.

Lucas: Add recurrence detection note: if cache_evictions_per_min > 80 for 5m OR 3 consecutive 95th latency spikes for same cohort -> flag regression. Who will add telemetry query?

Maya: I'll add a short telemetry query and threshold suggestion in the triage doc.

Lucas: OK. I'll schedule a 15m review the week after due dates to confirm PRs merged. Thanks all.
